title: Quality Datagram Payload
description: Payload for kind: quality datagrams. Emitted by the syn binary. Groups issues by (tool, code) pair with file-aggregated locations, and names every fault: a file an instrument could not examine, which is therefore not known to be clean.

faults.description: Every file that was not fully examined, with the instrument that could not do its work and why. Empty when every instrument ran.

total.description: Sum of all issue counts across all groups.

groups.description: One entry per unique (tool, code) combination.

message.description: Representative issue message (from the first issue in the group).

severity.description: Issue severity within the quality report.

count.description: Total number of issues in this group.

file_count.description: Number of unique files containing this issue.

detail.description: A gleipnir check's detail: the rule that was broken. Empty string for other tools. The four message fields are defined in the header of nornir's core/gleipnir_core/gleipnir_messages.toml.

signal.description: A gleipnir check's signal: why the rule exists. Empty string for other tools.

direction.description: A gleipnir check's direction: the one way forward. Empty string for other tools.

canary.description: A gleipnir check's canary, for the operator: the gaming move the check has been met with. Empty string for other tools.

locations.description: File-aggregated locations. Issues in the same file collapse into one entry.

file.description: The file that was not fully examined, or the sidecar syn could not use.

tool.description: The instrument that could not do its work (e.g. "gleipnir", "ruff", "basedpyright", "saga", "syn").

mode.description: The failure mode, by its name in nornir's error registry (failure_modes.toml).

class.description: The failure class of that mode.

message.description: What failed, where, and what to do next.

location.description: Single-line: { file, line }. Multi-line: { file, lines }. Exactly one of line or lines must be present.

file.description: File path relative to workspace root.

line.description: Line number (when file has exactly one issue in this group).

lines.description: Line numbers (when file has multiple issues in this group).
